disposition_reason: Table 3 prints mean Pb, Cd, Cr, Co, Zn and Fe for five herbal-extract flavoured alcoholic beverages bought in Ibadan motor parks.

study.design: Market survey of the five most consumed herbal-extract flavoured alcoholic beverages
study.origin: Not stated (Nigerian manufacturers, per label records)
study.market: Sale points at Ojoo, Sango, Iwo road, Gate and Dugbe motor parks, Ibadan, Nigeria
study.method: Flame AAS (Buck 200) after HNO3 concentration of 50 mL sample; AOAC methods
study.qa: NIST and Standard Organisation of Nigeria SRM said to be used; recoveries not reported
